sources.title: Notebook observation: large gaps sometimes retrace
sources.claim_summary: A large downward opening gap in a liquid stock may partially retrace during the session.

hypothesis: A sufficiently large downward opening gap in a liquid Korean stock may partially retrace intraday.
entry_rule: Buy only after a downward gap exceeds the configured threshold and a post-open reversal confirmation occurs.
exit_rule: Exit at the session close, a predefined retracement target, or a protective stop.
sizing_rule: Risk a fixed fraction of capital per signal with a maximum notional cap.
execution_assumptions: no fill before the confirmation bar

variants.description: Hold from the first eligible minute until the closing auction.

ambiguities: The gap threshold, confirmation definition, target, and stop require a pre-registered parameter choice.
